content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and kids this age do well with a gradual move. Tonight, build a short, predictable bedtime routine (bath, two books, lights out). Then sit on a chair beside his own bed until he's drowsy, and move the chair a bit farther from him every few nights. Tell him the plan in the daytime so it's not a surprise at bedtime, and praise him in the morning for any time he stays in his own bed.
